sources.name: IGS multi-GNSS merged broadcast ephemerides (RINEX 3), BKG GNSS Data Center
sources.licence: IGS Data and Product Terms of Use: open for scientific, educational and commercial use without restriction; attribution required
sources.attribution: Broadcast ephemerides: International GNSS Service (IGS) and BKG GNSS Data Center; navigation messages of GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, NavIC and SBAS operators

method: ICD Keplerian broadcast orbits (GPS, Galileo, BeiDou incl. GEO, QZSS, NavIC); RK4 of GLONASS/SBAS state vectors; nearest ephemeris per sample; samples after the last broadcast epoch are short extrapolations
